target: a needle starting with a dash is read by grep as an option and can never match, so any case asserting on a flag name is unusable
cmd:
mkdir -p c/syn
cat > c/syn/s.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "syn-2", "kind": "bash-unit", "target": "synthetic", "checks": [{"type": "must_find", "strings": ["--via requires a value"]}], "cmd": "echo '--via requires a value'"}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite syn >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
